title: Deficiency Resolution Band Schedule: Band Ranges, Opening Composition and Collection Conduct
content:
Every Deficiency Balance Account is placed in one of six Deficiency Resolution Bands according to the original deficiency on the opening date. The ranges below are inclusive at both ends.

| Band | Original deficiency on the opening date |
|---|---|
| Deficiency Resolution Band 1 | $0.01 to $2,500.00 |
| Deficiency Resolution Band 2 | $2,500.01 to $5,000.00 |
| Deficiency Resolution Band 3 | $5,000.01 to $8,000.00 |
| Deficiency Resolution Band 4 | $8,000.01 to $12,000.00 |
| Deficiency Resolution Band 5 | $12,000.01 to $18,000.00 |
| Deficiency Resolution Band 6 | $18,000.01 to $60,000.00 |

## Opening and conduct terms

The following terms are identical in all six bands (Band 1, Band 2, Band 3, Band 4, Band 5 and Band 6); no band departs from them.

| Term | Bands 1 to 6 |
|---|---|
| Components of the opening deficiency, in order | 1. contract principal after the sale proceeds; 2. contract fees due; 3. contract interest accrued to the sale date; 4. recovery expenses not covered by the proceeds |
| Basis of the band | the original deficiency on the opening date; an account is never re-banded |
| Whether no payment demand, plan or settlement offer is made before the post-sale explanation (UCC 9-616) has been mailed | yes |
| Whether interest accrues on a deficiency balance after the sale | no |
| Whether late, returned-payment or payment fees are charged on a deficiency account | no |
| Calendar days after the post-sale explanation within which the first deficiency demand letter is mailed | 15 |
| Calendar days within which a written dispute of the deficiency amount is answered, with collection paused meanwhile | 30 |
| Treatment of an account past the contract state's statute of limitations | no demand, plan or settlement is offered; the borrower is transferred to a human representative |
| Deficiency accounts per liquidated contract, count | 1 |

## Reading the schedule

- The band is read once, from the original deficiency on the opening date. A later payment, credit or returned payment changes the balance but never the band: an account that opened at $5,000.00 stays in Band 2 even after its balance falls below $2,500.01, and one that opened at $5,000.01 stays in Band 3.
- The boundaries sit one cent apart. A hypothetical original deficiency of exactly $2,500.00 is Band 1; one of $2,500.01 is Band 2.
- Because no band charges interest or fees, the balance of an account in any band moves only through the postings the account itself records.
